claims.text: MedInsight leverages Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation to augment patient-specific context with medical knowledge from textbooks and web resources.
The MedInsight framework operates in three sequential phases: patient context retrieval, medical knowledge retrieval, and response generation.
Subject Matter Expert qualitative evaluations confirm the factual correctness and relevance of responses generated by MedInsight.

evidence.description: The authors introduce MedInsight, a framework that uses LLMs and RAG to combine patient context from medical transcripts with trusted knowledge from textbooks and web resources.
The paper explicitly defines the three phases of MedInsight as patient context retrieval, medical knowledge retrieval, and response generation.
Qualitative evaluations conducted by Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) confirmed the relevance and factual correctness of the generated responses.

methodologies.name: MedInsight Context Augmentation Framework
methodologies.description: A three-phase retrieval-augmented generation framework combining patient record retrieval, domain-specific literature retrieval, and response synthesis.
conditions: Qualitative evaluation by Subject Matter Experts

limitations.text: Existing medical response approaches struggle to deliver personalized responses due to the distributed nature of medical data across patient records, literature, and online resources.
